I saved Dana's note that she uses Dock 38 for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups from now on. It's stored in gbrain as a private preference under her name. I confirmed this to her in your DM thread.

My first save was set to visible for everyone, even though I asked for it to be private. Anyone using gbrain could have looked it up. I expired that copy and saved it again as private (fact #2). It came from a direct message, so it shouldn't be visible to other members.

If anyone else saves a reminder with gbrain, set visibility to "private" explicitly. Asking for "not shared" wasn't enough to keep it private.
